follow-on: the command line reads  git show HEAD:... | uv run python -c <ancestor-held orphan fixture> , carrying a placeholder rather than the literal command, so the refusal (EXIT=1, AssertionError, ancestor-held: dropped_edge) cannot be reproduced from the log alone.
